definitions.explanation: Physical movement of one's body. Most commonly used in the negative form to describe being unable to move due to being trapped, crowded, or otherwise constrained.

examples.japanese: {身動|みうご}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れない→取れる：02376_toreru⟧。
⟦{満員|まんいん}{電車|でんしゃ}→満員電車：08350_manindensha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{身動|みうご}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れなかった→取れる：02376_toreru⟧。
examples.english: I couldn't move on the packed train.

examples.japanese: ⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}え→増える：01183_fueru⟧すぎて、⟦{経済的|けいざいてき}→経済的：05675_keizaiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{身動|みうご}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れない→取れる：02376_toreru⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧になってしまった。
examples.english: The debt piled up so much that I ended up in a situation where I couldn't move financially.

notes:
USAGE: {身動|みうご}き is almost always used in the negative pattern {身動|みうご}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れない→取れる：02376_toreru⟧ (unable to move). It can describe physical inability to move (in a crowd, when restrained) or figurative inability to act (due to financial problems, obligations, etc.).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {身動|みうご}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れない→取れる：02376_toreru⟧: unable to move, stuck
- {身動|みうご}き⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: unable to stir
- {身動|みうご}き⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧: not moving a muscle

The word is a compound of ⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧ (body) and ⟦{動|うご}き→動き：11926_ugoki⟧ (movement).
